observations.body: Peter calls Jesus a man attested by God, names human killing and divine resurrection, applies Davidic Psalms, and tells all Israel that God made Jesus Lord and Christ.
observations.label: Peter addresses Israel with resurrection and repentance: action

observations.body: hearers ask what to do and receive a call to repent and be baptized.
observations.label: Peter addresses Israel with resurrection and repentance: response

payload.posture: Read Acts 2:22–41 as israel in apostolic argument and final vision evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: Divine plan and human responsibility are asserted together, and “all Israel” is addressed through a Jerusalem crowd wider than one local faction.
payload.title: Peter addresses Israel with resurrection and repentance
